name: hud_sensor_tracker_project_world_points_to_overlay
description: HudSensorTracker::ProjectWorldPointsToOverlay projects world X/Z points into map-overlay coordinates using the tracked origin, tracked forward vector, current map scale, zoom, and overlay center.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x416c90 has no direct callees and returns 1; for nonzero pointCount it iterates input/output zVec3 arrays, subtracts trackedWorldOriginPtr x/z, applies mapZoom and mapScaleCurrent x/z, combines with trackedForwardVecPtr x/z, and stores projected overlay x/y relative to mapOverlayCenterX/Y.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x416c90 has no warnings or tags, but BN notes x87/post-increment artifacts around the output writes; assembly was used as the source of truth for the projection formulas.

The native smoke verifies pointCount zero preserves output points, then projects two world points with staged origin, forward vector, scale, zoom, and overlay center and checks the computed x/y coordinates.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x416c90 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
